state.invariant: Only valid professional proof can ratify an exact immutable rule digest, and active ratified rule version advances monotonically.
state.catalog: The selected IndependenceRuleRatificationCatalog event list contains the two engagement-use authorization and settlement facts, but omits IndependenceRuleRatificationRecorded. events.json separately assigns IndependenceRuleRatificationRecorded version 2 to this owner as a business fact.
state.code: The owner appends and folds IndependenceRuleRatificationRecorded to advance its current authority. The ratify operation rereads current rule draft and ratifier duty and staff proofs, prepares and writes immutable content, then appends to the ratification stream. It takes no source-owner hold between the reread and append. The ratification owner checks its own physical and native cut, not source-owner cuts. The ratification event carries business header, native sequence, operation provenance and immutable first response and result references. The public RatifyIndependenceRuleVersion handler builds a root operation with root equal logical ID and null causation; the owner now rejects nonnull causation.
